label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method metrics to measure effectiveness. First-pass rate: % of outputs that pass Santa on round 1 (target >70%). Mean iterations to convergence: average rounds to NICE (target <1.5). Issue taxonomy: distribution of failure types (hallucination vs. completeness vs. compliance). Reviewer agreement: % of issues flagged by both reviewers vs. only one (low agreement = rubric needs tightening). Escape rate: issues found post-ship that Santa should have caught (target: 0). Cost analysis: Santa Method costs ~2-3x token cost of generation alone per verification cycle. For batch operations, sampling pattern reduces cost to ~15-20% of full verification while catching >90% of systematic issues. Cost of Santa = generation tokens + 2×(review tokens per round) × (avg rounds). Cost of NOT Santa = reputation damage + correction effort + trust erosion.
